scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.migrate:railway: sh -c 'test -n "$SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN" || { echo "SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN is required"; exit 1; }; test -n "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" || { echo "SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF is required"; exit 1; }; test -n "$SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD" || { echo "SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD is required"; exit 1; }; supabase link --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" --password "$SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD" --yes && supabase db push --password "$SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD" --yes'
